findings.evidence: Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Ring/Ideal.lean:71 `instance topologicalRingQuotientTopology : TopologicalSpace (R ⧸ N)`; Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Group/Quotient.lean:87 `DiscreteTopology (G ⧸ N) ↔ IsOpen (N : Set G)`; example file `local instance : TopologicalSpace (powerBoundedSubring ℂ_[p] ⧸ ...) := ⊥`.
findings.fix: Drop both binders in `continuous_teichmuller₀`, `isHomeomorph_quotientMulEquiv` and `isHomeomorph_plusEquiv`. Use Mathlib's quotient topology and add a public `IsAdic.discreteTopology_quotient` (I is open, so the quotient is discrete). Remove the local `⊥` instances from the example.
findings.issue: `[TopologicalSpace (R ⧸ I)] [DiscreteTopology (R ⧸ I)]` clashes with Mathlib's global `topologicalRingQuotientTopology` on `R ⧸ I`. The same binders appear in `isHomeomorph_plusEquiv` (Plus.lean:244), and the example file has to install a second, local `⊥` topology on `powerBoundedSubring ℂ_[p] ⧸ (p)`. The proof's `hmk` step re-proves continuity of `Ideal.Quotient.mk`.

findings.evidence: Perfection.lean:93 `(continuous_coeffMonoidHom (M := R ⧸ I) (p := p) n).continuousAt` used for `coeff (R ⧸ I) p n`; grep finds no `continuous_coeff` for `Perfection` in code or mathlib.
findings.fix: Add `@[continuity, fun_prop]` `continuous_coeff` and `continuous_pthRoot` for ring perfections. State `continuous_iff` as `∀ n, Continuous fun x ↦ coeffMonoidHom M p n (f x)`, moving it to the CommMonoid section if needed.
findings.issue: Missing characteristic continuity lemmas: there is no `continuous_coeff` for the ring hom `Perfection.coeff` (the normal form used by `Perfection.ext`) and no `continuous_pthRoot`. `continuous_teichmuller₀` gets continuity of `coeff` from `continuous_coeffMonoidHom` only by unfolding definitions. `continuous_iff` exposes the raw subtype field `(f x).val n` instead of `coeffMonoidHom`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/RingTheory/Teichmuller.lean:206 has only `coeff_zero_symm_quotientMulEquiv`; Perfection.lean:120-139 proves the general n case inline.
findings.fix: Make them public lemmas next to the algebraic Teichmüller API, e.g. `pthRootMonoidHom_symm_quotientMulEquiv` and a `@[simp]` `coeffMonoidHom_symm_quotientMulEquiv`, and use them in the proof.
findings.issue: General algebraic facts about Mathlib's `quotientMulEquiv` are hidden in local `have`s: `hs` (the inverse commutes with taking p-th roots, `pthRootMonoidHom`) and `he` (`coeffMonoidHom R p n (symm x) = teichmuller₀ p I (pthRootMonoidHom^[n] x)`). Neither uses topology, and `he` is the missing n-th-coordinate counterpart of `coeff_zero_symm_quotientMulEquiv`.

summary: The homeomorphism theorems take their own residue-ring topology, which clashes with Mathlib's quotient topology on `R ⧸ I`. The new Perfection topology also lacks its ring-level characteristic lemmas, and general facts about `quotientMulEquiv` are hidden inside a proof.
